problem_text:
A logistics company must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance at ten distinct facilities across a region.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Bravo: 89.6 minutes
* Alpha to Charlie: 69.3 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 51.9 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 97.7 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 69.1 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 43.0 minutes
* Alpha to Hotel: 81.0 minutes
* Alpha to India: 33.5 minutes
* Alpha to Juliett: 64.9 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 23.3 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 95.1 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 184.6 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 133.0 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 106.3 minutes
* Bravo to Hotel: 150.9 minutes
* Bravo to India: 105.0 minutes
* Bravo to Juliett: 26.4 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 72.0 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 166.2 minutes
* Charlie to Foxtrot: 109.7 minutes
* Charlie to Golf: 92.7 minutes
* Charlie to Hotel: 127.6 minutes
* Charlie to India: 89.4 minutes
* Charlie to Juliett: 18.4 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 131.5 minutes
* Delta to Foxtrot: 38.6 minutes
* Delta to Golf: 94.8 minutes
* Delta to Hotel: 57.2 minutes
* Delta to India: 85.2 minutes
* Delta to Juliett: 80.6 minutes
* Echo to Foxtrot: 116.0 minutes
* Echo to Golf: 84.6 minutes
* Echo to Hotel: 109.8 minutes
* Echo to India: 81.6 minutes
* Echo to Juliett: 158.4 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 107.5 minutes
* Foxtrot to Hotel: 18.8 minutes
* Foxtrot to India: 96.9 minutes
* Foxtrot to Juliett: 116.1 minutes
* Golf to Hotel: 115.4 minutes
* Golf to India: 10.6 minutes
* Golf to Juliett: 80.1 minutes
* Hotel to India: 104.9 minutes
* Hotel to Juliett: 133.0 minutes
* India to Juliett: 78.6 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the technician to visit every facility precisely once before concluding the circuit by returning to the initial point of departure.
